title: The Rt. Rev. John Coleridge Patteson
dates: (1827-20 Sept 1871)
---

missionary Bishop of Melanesia

He was killed in the Santa Cruz or Queen Charlotte Islands, the outer part of the New Hebrides, now administratively part of the Solomon Islands  [ILN 9 Dec 1871 559 text 561 picture;  Oxford Hammond Atlas of the World; Sir John Gutch Martyr of the Islands (1971); ODNB]
